message.subject: MUTOH + protective films at PRINTING United?
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Saw that MUTOH is exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo this October—congrats on the recent Pinnacle Awards.

I'm reaching out because we work with several printer manufacturers whose customers (wrap shops, sign makers) struggle with graphics degrading outdoors faster than expected. Our protective films have helped these partners reduce warranty callbacks and strengthen their customer relationships.

Would you be open to a brief conversation about how a partnership might look for PRINTING United? Could even explore a booth collaboration if timing works.

Happy to send some examples of what we've done with similar companies first if that's easier.

Best,
[Your name]
